input_compatibility.legacy_policy: read and time-slice only when shot_events are absent; uncertain mapping returns REVIEW_REQUIRED or BLOCKED

invariants: Every addition must have a narrative or continuity reason.
No decorative camera movement: movement without motivation defaults to LOCKED/STATIC.
Stage 07 may refine execution but may not change story facts, shot timing ownership, locked asset identity, or Stage 06 audio event facts.
Every Stage 06 shot event remains traceable by event_id and is either inherited, linked to a director directive, or explicitly marked for review.
Stage 07 camera_movement refines Stage 06 camera_intent; movement_motivation is required for dynamic movement and LOCKED/STATIC is the explicit default.
Approved English names/dialogue remain unchanged; operator-facing production labels and diagnostics are Chinese by default.
